best: The power paths (3V3 buck input cap bank to inductor to output, and the USB four-switch stage with input/output banks around the H-bridge) read cleanly left to right like textbook drawings.
worst: Gauge (U101) area on Cells sheet has overlapping text: TH101/R113 labels collide, C105 sits on CELL_1N text, thermistors cramped against TS pins, and D101/TS NTC connectors/Q103 float alone tied only by labels.
USB sheets are oversized with tiny parts and large empty regions; BQ25756 gate resistors R444-R447 have overlapping ref/value text and long wandering wires to ACUV/ACOV/CE_N/TS.
Many support parts (USB U405/VBIAS caps, MCU pull-ups far from the module, MCU TP301) are placed away from the pins they serve, leaving pages unbalanced with empty lower halves.
